nondegeneracy.verdict: p2 is NOT a function of p1 on this inventory: a degree-5 polynomial leaves a max residual of 0.980 on a feature whose range is [-1, 1], and the radius has sd 0.251 where the frozen2d family has sd 8.3e-17 (it is exactly unit by construction). doc 54 SS3.1's degeneracy -- the one that made the frozen2d version of this experiment a reparameterisation -- does not hold on the raw family, so exp68 is width-as-INFORMATION.

features.instrument_FA_note: doc 54 SS6.2 writes FA as atan2(PC2, PC1) -- the UNNORMALISED components, i.e. the existing exp42 map -- and that is what this runtime uses, asserted above to 4.0e-15 rad. instrument_sb_bounds.features() computes FA as atan2(p2, p1) on its NORMALISED coords, which on the raw family is a different angle (max difference 7.9e-02 rad). The BOUND is unaffected and the two agree exactly at 148/160: the normalisation is a positive-diagonal linear map of the plane, which preserves the cyclic order of the referents, and a d = 3 single-angle bound depends only on that order. diagnostic_sb_bounds.json carries both computations and they match -- raw FA per-twin 163/190 equals frozen2d FA per-twin 163/190 for tertiary, and the non-occupational target reads 148/160 under the raw-family FA (target_selection.table) and 148/160 under the frozen2d FA, which IS the exp42 map (membership_reconstruction). A TRAINED CIRCUIT is not invariant to the rescaling even though the bound is -- the same reasoning doc 54 SS3.2 gives for pinning the PC signs -- so the doc's literal formula governs the runtime.

intro_state_assertions.preparation_doc61_SS6_6: the intro is a FIXED, DATA-VALUED, ZERO-PARAMETER unitary and its only requirement is that it produce |psi(x)> exactly. It is built as a Moettoenen-style cascade of 2^q - 1 UNIFORMLY CONTROLLED RY rotations, one level per wire, with the SIGNS carried by the last level's rotations -- so it is visibly A CIRCUIT and not a single opaque gate, and it cannot become a silent second architecture. NO EXP73 VERDICT DEPENDS ON WHICH PREPARATION CIRCUIT IS USED, AND NONE MAY.
intro_state_assertions.precision_note: the simulator is complex64 END TO END (torch_sv_sim.CDTYPE, unchanged since exp40 and LEFT ALONE here because the drift anchor's bit-exactness depends on it), so the runtime agreement floor is ~1.2e-07 and doc 61's 1e-9 / 1e-12 thresholds are BELOW the simulator's resolution. Loosening a registered threshold to make a gate pass would be changing a gate after seeing the platform, so the build does the other thing: the intro is recomputed in complex128 from the model's OWN data through the SAME gate sequence, held to the runtime state at float32 tolerance so it is provably the same circuit, and doc 61's thresholds are asserted against it AS WRITTEN. Both numbers are reported. exp70's precision split, verbatim.
intro_state_assertions.sign_blindness_note_doc61_SS7_2_1: THE FAILING DIRECTION IS THE POINT: the outer-square feature v(x) is invariant under x -> -x, so a sign error on any amplitude would be INVISIBLE TO THE BOUND and FATAL TO THE CIRCUIT. The assertion is on the STATE, amplitude by amplitude, and `check_failing_directions` demonstrates that flipping one amplitude's sign fires it.

closure_doc61_SS7_4.why_not: doc 61 SS7.4: doc 56 SS7.1's closure gates test whether a compiled intro spans a claimed TRIGONOMETRIC basis. The amplitude intro has NO ANGLE PARAMETERISATION AT ALL -- x is a point on a sphere, not a function of angles -- so closure in any trigonometric basis is UNDEFINED, not merely uninformative. A gate that cannot fail is not a gate (doc 49 SS8, orchestrator ruling 6 of doc 56). Validity for the amplitude arms is asserted by SS7.2 items 1-4 instead, which are STRICTLY STRONGER: they pin the STATE itself rather than the span it lies in.

the_exact_relation_that_IS_asserted_doc6.identity: L v(phi) = u(2 phi), v = (x0^2, x0 x1, x1^2)

closure_doc61_SS7_4.reading: at q = 1 the amplitude feature v(phi) = (x0^2, x0 x1, x1^2) is carried to the committed single-angle feature u(2 phi) by a FIXED INVERTIBLE L -- the amplitude map is the single-angle map AT DOUBLE FREQUENCY, not at the same frequency. doc 61 SS2.2 records that `amplitude == u(phi)` FAILS on 28 of 30 random inventories, so the committed inventory's agreement is A COINCIDENCE AND EXPLICITLY NOT A FINDING; and A3/A4's 36- and 136-dimensional feature spaces have no angle analogue at all.

separation_check_from_the_instrument.reading: the doubled-angle identity is a THEOREM and holds on every inventory; the same-angle agreement is an INVENTORY-SPECIFIC COINCIDENCE and fails on most random inventories. Amplitude encoding of a unit 2-vector is therefore NOT a reparameterisation of the committed angle encoding -- it is the same feature space at double frequency, which reorders the inventory around the circle.

word_order.archived_source: archive/01_parser_pipeline/arabic_dep_reader.py:130-138 (the two verb boxes), :167-180 (_vso and its Swap)
word_order.verdict: SS7.3 DISCHARGED as DERIVATION-DIFFERS / DENOTATION-EQUAL, and the reconciliation is stated rather than buried. The compiled derivations differ -- the VSO reduction carries `Swap(N.l, N)` and the SVO reduction does not -- so the compiler genuinely consults the surface, which is the null-instrument failure SS7.3 exists to catch. The DENOTATIONS are equal (max diff 0.0e+00), which is not a defect but doc 55 SS16.1-Q2's USER-CONFIRMED premise that the two orders are truth-conditionally identical, and which is REQUIRED by SS4.7 ('the same six blocks, reused'), by SS5's 12/72 conditioning-group arithmetic (no surface-order factor) and by SS6.1 (A0 must reproduce exp68 bit-exactly on a dataset that already contains both orders). The Swap is LOAD-BEARING and that is measured, not argued: dropping it moves the state by 1.034 and yields EXACTLY the role-reversed circuit (diff 0.0e+00) -- without the Swap, the VSO clause would say the object did it. CONSEQUENCE FOR THE CLAIM, carried: the circuit is invariant to the alternation by construction, so doc 55 SS6.9's per-surface-order accuracy is a DATA-COMPOSITION statistic and is not evidence about word-order processing. ORCHESTRATOR REVIEW ITEM.

shuffle.note: doc 61 SS15.1: THE FLOOR IS PROCEDURE-MATCHED AND THE INIT IS PART OF THE PROCEDURE -- a floor measured under one optimisation procedure does not bound what another can achieve on severed labels, so the two inits are two procedures and EACH CELL GETS ITS OWN FLOOR. Bearer designation is reassigned PER PAIR and independently of the features, so twins stay on opposite labels and V1 stays exactly 0.500. THE DRIFT ANCHOR CARRIES NO FRESH FLOOR (SS5.3.1): it is pinned to within 0.002 of a measurement that cleared its own matched floor by 8.02 floor-SD units. IF THE ANCHOR FAILS ITS GATE, THAT ARGUMENT IS VOID ALONG WITH THE RUN.
